log.notes_to_self: Day1: no kills, observing. Strategy: need to avoid pool<=1000 at end of day; score multipliers need 30 kills in 5 days. Free blocks for me: morning, afternoon. Use quick entries (deaths in morning/afternoon). Traces: victims reported only in national are safe.

Day1: no kills, observing. Day2: killed a few to test, quick entries in morning/afternoon only (my free blocks). Strategy: avoid pool<=1000 at end of day; multipliers need 30 kills in 5 days (x2) or 40 (x4). Traces hit 3 random deaths/day; national-only victims are safe. Prefer victims reported only in national or in places L cannot reach. Watch press conferences (every 3 days) for pool shrinkage.

Day3: killed national d3-7 plus a few. Strategy: need to balance kill count vs pool shrink. Free blocks for me: morning, afternoon only. Use quick entries in morning/afternoon (no timed needed). Watch press conference after day 3 (pool) to infer which place types L can reach. National-only victims are safe. Prefer kills not at risk. Multipliers need 30 kills in 5 days (x2) or 40 (x4); consider a burst later while pool is still large.

Day4: pool was 3000 after day3 (from 100000). Danger: <=1000 at end of a day = caught, lose half. Day2-3 I killed national, blotter, radio, forum (4/day) and the pool fell fast. Day4: killed only the national criminal (safe, traces tell L nothing). Free blocks: morning, afternoon only; use quick entries. Keep killing only national-only victims unless the pool stabilizes. Next press conference after day 6; if the pool stays at 3000, then the places I killed in on days 2-3 were mostly unreachable by L, and I can reconsider. Avoid evening/night kills.
